description: Handler classification registry for the soft namespace-governance rule (docs/architecture/module-namespace-governance.md, Rule 2). Every EventHandler impl a production file declares must appear here with one of the ADR-62 D4 categories. The populating classification is the Phase 0 census (docs/architecture/handler-census-phase0.md §3); scripts/verify-namespace-governance.py fails when a NEW impl type is absent, and deliberately does not re-grade existing rows.

categories.command_contributor: Runs synchronously in the sale transaction and may reject it (ADR-62 D1/D2).
categories.projection_subscriber: Runs after commit, derives a projection, may not reject the sale (ADR-62 D1/D3).
categories.query_facade: Serves reads through a sanctioned facade (ADR-62 D4/D5).
categories.lifecycle: Module load/start/stop hook; not a seam (ADR-62 D6).
categories.plugin_bridge: Bridges an event to an external surface, e.g. the LAN fan-out (ADR-62 D6).
categories.internal_helper: Support code with no seam contract (ADR-62 D6).

handlers.name: LoyaltyEarnHandler

handlers.name: InventoryStockHandler
handlers.note: DEAD / test-only: constructed nowhere in production. Its BOM deduction duplicates the in-transaction Store path; see the Phase 0 census headline correction. Kept classified so a future re-subscription is not mistaken for new work.
